label: Thomas Aquinas, Summa theologiae I q.13 a.5…: In predications all univocal predicates are reduced…
locator: I q.13 a.5 ad 1: sicut in praedicationibus omnia univoca reducuntur ad unum primum, non univocum, sed analogicum, quod est ens
interpretation: Read as stated, in the simile of ad 1: all univocal predicates reduce to one first predicate that is analogical, not univocal, namely being. Not formalized. Together with q.3 a.5 it gives Aquinas' grounds for not treating being as a genus with one homogeneous scale.
